messages.text: Does the Section 31 20 00 required compaction density for the structural fill under the building pad shown on Grading Plan C-201 hold up against the geotechnical report's requirements for this area? We'd like this confirmed ahead of the next civil inspection. We don't anticipate any effect on the contract sum. No schedule impact is anticipated. Please respond within five days so we can schedule the civil inspection.

Detail 6/C-601 directly addresses the Section 31 20 00 required compaction density for the structural fill under the building pad per the geotechnical review; the civil inspector should be able to sign off as documented.
